paragraphs: The “Vehicles & Parts” category is a top-level department in Shopify’s product taxonomy. It brings together the product families assigned to Vehicles & Parts, providing the starting point for classification throughout this branch of the catalog. Its immediate branches include Vehicle Parts & Accessories, Vehicles.

When describing products in Vehicles & Parts, useful Shopify classification details include Color: Defines the primary color or pattern, such as blue or striped. These are descriptive comparison points rather than required GitStore category fields; retain the product’s actual characteristics when choosing a category. Where an immediate branch describes the product more precisely, follow that branch and continue to the most appropriate specific category.
